record.label: Forward common-radial pair-reset replacement
record.summary: Retain total covariance C and the paid quadratic Gram Q, set L=C-Q, and replace the Q24 pair reset by the exact expectation of biased Gaussian ReLU moments under C(S)=L+S Q. Means and covariance are computed together, so the replacement plane is PSD and needs no reverse tape.
record.terminal_criterion: Pass both PSD synchronization gates, the finite-matrix common-scale model error, complete-old semantics, and endpoint raw value.
